g.text: 1. Pipe/fittings/flanges per class S2 (CFU-000-PI-SPC-001); BW fittings ASME B16.9, flanges B16.5/B16.47A RF.
2. Hydrotest 81.1 barg per ASME B31.3 345.4 (vents at high points, drains at low points).
3. PWHT: YES (P-No.4) 705-745 C. NDE: 100 % RT of BW; 100 % MT/PT of fillets; HB <= 225; 100 % PMI.
4. Supports: RS rest/shoe, GD guide, ANC anchor, SPR variable spring - tags PS-<area><seq>-nn.
5. Welds: dot = shop weld, crossed circle FW = field weld; spools <= 12 m for transport.
6. Branch taken from top of HP header; line falls to E-116 - drains into shell (no pocket).
7. S2 (P11) - PWHT and 100 % RT; hot bolting check at 430 C.
ISOMETRIC VIEW - NOT TO SCALE - DIMENSIONS IN mm, ELEVATIONS / COORDINATES IN m (PLANT GRID)
100 % RT of BW; 100 % MT/PT of fillets;
CAT 1 - T > 300 C & NPS >= 6; 600# class & T > 200
HS / V HP steam to stabiliser r
PIPE SCH 40, BE, ASTM A335 P11 SMLS
ELBOW 90 LR, BW, SCH 40, ASTM A234 WP11
FLANGE WN RF CL600 B16.5, bore SCH 40, ASTM A182 F11
ERECTION: GATE VALVE OS&Y CL600 RF, A217 WC6, trim 8
GLOBE VALVE CL600 RF, A217 WC6, trim 8
GASKET SPW 304/graphite, outer ring, CL600 B16.20
STUD BOLT SET (nuts) A193 B7 / A194 2H, CL600
PIPE SUPPORTS (std. dwgs): guide x1, rest x6
CUT LENGTHS (mm, ex. weld gap) / SPOOLS
